subject: Data Engineering
title: The Table Format War
description: A 60-second lesson on The Table Format War.

hook.text: Delta, Iceberg, or Hudi? The data industry spent years debating which table format would win.

buildup.text: Delta had Databricks. Iceberg had Netflix and Apple. Hudi had Uber and AWS. Each had massive backers.

discovery.text: The formats are converging. Databricks now supports Iceberg. Snowflake adopted Iceberg natively. AWS supports all three.

twist.text: Interoperability may matter more than picking a winner. Engines that read all formats eliminate the lock-in risk.

climax.text: The war is cooling. The real winner is the open lakehouse concept itself, regardless of which format prevails.

punchline.text: The format matters less than the openness behind it.

quiz.question: What is the emerging trend in the table format competition?
options: Convergence and interoperability across all three formats
One format completely replacing the others
